reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need a version that goes with me. On my budget I'm not paying for sachets when I already have a bottle.
objection: I already have magnesium at home and take it in the evening there. Paying around a dollar a day for the same thing in a foil pack is money I don't need to spend.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now for a bottle, or a travel trip where I'd actually forget my own supply.
